project: Sector Forge 1.0 — 10×12 grid and Sectors Without Number import foundation
scope: Validation of the updated package. This release adds a 10×12 grid and a tested SWN import foundation; it does not claim complete feature parity with every upstream entity editor or faction workflow. See FEATURE_PARITY.md.

javascript_syntax.command: node --check applied to all .js and .cjs files

native_json_fixture.coordinates: SWN one-based entity coordinates converted to zero-based Forge coordinates; route/layer hex keys stay zero-based

swn_import_validation.notes: The native JSON fixture is modeled on the upstream source exporter. A real JSON export from the currently hosted upstream app has not yet been added as a fixture.

coverage: system survey rendering and responsive behavior
chromium_end_to_end.environment_note: Localhost browser navigation is blocked in this environment; the offline-inline browser suite exercised the app HTML/CSS/JavaScript and bundled local data without uncaught browser errors.

zip_integrity.final_extracted_tests: All passed; see test logs summarized above.

feature_parity_note: Original native JSON payloads and source records are kept in the GM archive. Several upstream entity types are visible as survey objects and/or source records, but all entity-specific editors are not yet implemented. Imported navigation paths are separate from Forge trade routes; layers are flattened into Forge's region model; imported SWN factions remain reference records instead of active Forge faction-simulation objects. See FEATURE_PARITY.md.
